title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
title_zh: SkillProx：通过近端文本梯度下降实现自进化 Agent 技能
abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly adapt to recurring tasks by accumulating procedural knowledge in skills. These skills are lightweight, reusable textual artifacts that are loaded into the agent's context without weight updates. Recent methods refine skills through iterative task execution, failure diagnosis, and trajectory-guided text-space updates. However, existing frameworks lack explicit diagnosis--outcome feedback and treat deletion as a generic edit operation rather than a dedicated mechanism for consolidating accumulated knowledge. We introduce SkillProx, a proximal-gradient-inspired forward--backward framework that couples closed-loop diagnostic evolution with utility-aware proximal refinement. Motivated by a composite objective balancing task loss and skill complexity, the forward stage re-executes diagnosis-driven edits on the same task batch, rolls back regressions, and feeds measured outcomes into subsequent diagnoses. The backward stage decomposes the resulting skill into auditable knowledge units, estimates their contributions using a frozen leave-one-out utility audit, and applies validation-gated consolidation, demotion, or removal. Experiments on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks across multiple backbone LLMs show that SkillProx improves average accuracy by 3.0 percentage points over the strongest gradient-based baseline. Component ablations demonstrate the complementary effects of closed-loop diagnosis and proximal refinement.
abstract_zh: LLM agents 越来越多地通过积累程序性知识（skills）来适应重复任务。这些 skills 是轻量、可复用的文本资产，可直接加载到 agent 上下文中，无需更新模型权重。现有方法通常通过迭代执行任务、诊断失败并基于轨迹在文本空间中更新 skills，但缺乏显式的“诊断—结果”反馈机制，也往往将删除视为普通编辑操作，而不是用于整合累积知识的专门机制。本文提出 SkillProx，一个受近端梯度启发的 forward-backward 框架，将闭环诊断演化与效用感知的近端精炼结合起来。其 forward 阶段在同一任务批次上重新执行诊断驱动的编辑，回滚性能退化的修改，并将实测结果反馈给后续诊断；backward 阶段将 skill 分解为可审计的知识单元，通过冻结的 leave-one-out 效用审计估计其贡献，并基于验证门控执行整合、降级或移除。多种 backbone LLM 上的分布内与分布外实验表明，SkillProx 相比最强的梯度式基线平均准确率提升 3.0 个百分点；消融实验验证了闭环诊断与近端精炼的互补作用。
key_points_zh: 提出 SkillProx，将 LLM agent 的 textual skills 优化形式化为兼顾任务损失与 skill 复杂度的复合目标，并借鉴 proximal gradient 构建 forward-backward 更新流程。
forward 阶段引入闭环诊断：在同一任务批次上执行诊断驱动编辑，检测并回滚导致性能退化的修改，再把真实结果反馈给后续诊断，减少盲目文本更新。
backward 阶段进行效用感知的近端精炼：把 skill 拆成可审计知识单元，用冻结的 leave-one-out utility audit 估计贡献，并执行整合、降级或删除。
实验覆盖分布内与分布外 benchmark 以及多个 backbone LLM，SkillProx 相比最强 gradient-based baseline 平均准确率提升 3.0 个百分点。
组件消融显示，closed-loop diagnosis 与 proximal refinement 分别带来收益，且二者具有互补性。

llm_assessment.comment: This is highly aligned skill-evolution work with closed-loop diagnosis, rollback, utility auditing, and validation-gated consolidation of reusable skills.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这篇论文高度契合技能演化方向，结合了闭环诊断、回滚、效用审计和验证门控的可复用技能整合。
